Title: Power Apps mobile app users experience intermittent sign-in failures

User impact: Power Apps mobile app users experience intermittent sign-in failures.

More Info: Impact is limited to signing-in to new sessions and signing back in to a session after signing out. Users who are already signed are not affected until their cached tokens expire.

Users receive the error message "No network connection. Please check your network settings and try again." upon failure.

As a workaround, we recommend that:
• Use Power Apps in a web browser until this is mitigated.
• Users who are still signed in shouldn't sign out, clear app data, or reinstall.

Current Status: Our monitoring alerted us to an issue where Power Apps mobile app users experience intermittent sign-in failures. Our investigation identified that an internal upstream service dependency, Exchange, which supports the sign-in functionality, is experiencing a service outage. This service outage has caused sign-in requests to intermittently fail at the authorization step. We are monitoring service diagnostics for recovery as actions are performed to mitigate the service outage on Exchange.

Next Update: Friday, November 13, 2026, at 9:00 AM UTC
